Use case: identity-preserve. Production desktop pet sprite atlas.
Input image 1 is the ONLY source of character identity, hair, face, body proportions, skin, clothing, shoes and rendering style. Input image 2 is ONLY a layout and hand-gesture reference; do not copy its face, hair, outfit or rendering style.
Create a new square transparent PNG, exactly 3 columns x 3 rows with NINE SMALL FULL-BODY sprites of the clearly ADULT woman in image 1. Keep image 1's REALISTIC DIGITAL HUMAN appearance, natural adult proportions, realistic face, skin and hair; DO NOT adopt the stylized cartoon face from image 2. Preserve her exact current swim outfit in all nine frames. Every figure has the same body height and planted feet. Make each complete figure only 65 percent of its cell height, with large completely transparent padding ABOVE and BELOW every head and shoe. All nine figures' shoes, hats and long dresses must fit inside the canvas. Never crop feet, never crowd rows.
Use the gesture sequence from image 2: top row 1 right HAND holds small bread roll at chest, 2 right HAND brings bread to mouth to take bite, 3 lowers bitten bread, cheeks gently chewing. Middle row 4 left HAND holds blue rice bowl, right fingers grasp spoon at bowl, 5 spoon at mouth while bowl stays in left hand, 6 spoon returns to bowl. Bottom row 7 both hands extended open around an empty round space at chest height, 8 elbows gently flex as hands recoil accepting an invisible small ball, 9 both HANDS cradle that EMPTY space at chest. Catching hands are always spaced apart around a round gap, NEVER touching palms or fingertips together, no prayer hands. Draw NO ball in bottom row. Elbows are below hands. Human arms connect shoulder to elbow to wrist to fingers correctly. Food actually touches fingers or spoon, never attached to elbows.
Fixed frontal camera and consistent proportions. Respect the exact reference face and rendering. Clean true alpha outside every silhouette. NO glow, NO colored fringes, NO scattered white pixels or debris, NO background or ground shadows, NO text or gridlines. Anatomically coherent hands in all nine poses.
Critical production constraints: IGNORE and REMOVE the backlight/glow/halo behind the original reference. Only draw the person, with a precise crisp silhouette directly adjoining fully zero-alpha empty space. No lighting aura. All nine bodies MUST have the SAME LEG LENGTH AND SAME ADULT HEAD-TO-BODY RATIO, including the bottom row. Do NOT progressively shorten legs or enlarge the head in lower rows. Scale entire figures uniformly if you need space. Bottom row should still be about 7 heads tall. Preserve the adult face proportions of image 1.
